name: Huschke von Hanstein
features: fair skin, blond hair combed back, bright blue eyes, round open face, ready smile, trim athletic build, sociable confident bearing
bio: The Racing Baron. He won the 1940 Mille Miglia with Walter Bäumer in the streamlined BMW 328 coupé, one of only three non-Italians ever to win the race. After the war he ran Porsche’s racing and press departments from 1952 to 1968, taking the marque’s first major victory himself at the 1956 Targa Florio in a 550 Spyder shared with Umberto Maglioli.
